name: The Mimeoplasm
oracle_text: As The Mimeoplasm enters, you may exile two creature cards from graveyards. If you do, it enters as a copy of one of those cards with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the power of the other card.
blocked_sentences: As The Mimeoplasm enters, you may exile two creature cards from graveyards. If you do, it enters as a copy of one of those cards with a number of additional +1/+1 counters on it equal to the power of the other card.

needs.what: an as-enters replacement (614.1c / 707.9) that optionally exiles exactly two creature cards from any graveyards as the permanent arrives; if both were exiled, the controller picks one of them as the copy model (the permanent enters with that card's copiable values) and it enters with additional +1/+1 counters equal to the printed power of the other exiled card. Needs: a graveyard (any player) card pool instead of a battlefield permanent pool, an exile-N-as-you-may step bound by name, a choice of which bound card is the model, and an `enters_with` counter amount reading `power_of` the other bound card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The packet's reference lists no replacement vocabulary at all (`self_enters_as_copy` is not in it). The engine's `self_enters_as_copy` (`offer_enters_copy`) picks one object from a `copying` pool and copies it, with no exile step, no second card, and its `except_.enters_with` amount cannot bind the other exiled card's power. A `self_enters` trigger with `exile` + `become_copy` + `add_counters` would make the copy and counters a later effect, so a 0/0 Mimeoplasm dies to state-based actions before the trigger resolves, and `become_copy`/`copy_permanent` copy permanents, not cards in exile
